preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: 'Adjust pH to 6.7 - 6.8; gas atmosphere: 100% CO2.'
- step_number: 2
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients except carbohydrates, Na2CO3, cysteine and sodium
    sulfide in distilled water, boil for 5 min, then cool to room temperature while
    gassing with 100% CO2. Add Na2CO3 and equilibrate the medium with the gas to pH
    6.8. Distribute under CO2 in rubber-stoppered tubes (i.e. Hungate tubes) and autoclave.
    Thereafter add carbohydrate mixture, cysteine and sodium sulfide from concentrated
    sterile stock solutions (prepared anaerobically under N2 gas and autoclaved).
applications:
- Microbial cultivation

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: 'Adjust pH to 6.7 - 6.8; gas atmosphere: 100% CO2.'
- step_number: 2
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients except carbohydrates, Na2CO3, cysteine and sodium
    sulfide in distilled water, boil for 5 min, then cool to room temperature while
    gassing with 100% CO2. Add Na2CO3 and equilibrate the medium with the gas to pH
    6.8. Distribute under CO2 in rubber-stoppered tubes (i.e. Hungate tubes) and autoclave.
    Thereafter add carbohydrate mixture, cysteine and sodium sulfide from concentrated
    sterile stock solutions (prepared anaerobically under N2 gas and autoclaved).
applications:
- Microbial cultivation

  Source: https://togomedium.org/medium/M1093
  Original source: JCM - JCM_M1029
  Original URL: https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=1029

  Original JCM1029 is unavailable. Do not transfer DSMZ330's nominal denominator to this source. Split the 960 ml main water from the 1 L mineral-stock water; retain exact mg inputs and unquantified CO2. Provider preparation text: Adjust pH to 6.7 -- 6.8; gas atmosphere: 100% CO2.
  Dissolve ingredients except carbohydrates, Na2CO3, cysteine and sodium sulfide in distilled water, boil for 5 min, then cool to room temperature while gassing with 100% CO2. Add Na2CO3 and equilibrate the medium with the gas to pH 6.8. Distribute under CO2 in rubber-stoppered tubes (i.e. Hungate tubes) and autoclave. Thereafter add carbohydrate mixture, cysteine and sodium sulfide from concentrated sterile stock solutions (prepared anaerobically under N2 gas and autoclaved).

Original JCM1029 is unavailable. Do not transfer DSMZ330's nominal denominator to this source. Split the 960 ml main water from the 1 L mineral-stock water; retain exact mg inputs and unquantified CO2. Provider preparation text: Adjust pH to 6.7 -- 6.8; gas atmosphere: 100% CO2.
Dissolve ingredients except carbohydrates, Na2CO3, cysteine and sodium sulfide in distilled water, boil for 5 min, then cool to room temperature while gassing with 100% CO2. Add Na2CO3 and equilibrate the medium with the gas to pH 6.8. Distribute under CO2 in rubber-stoppered tubes (i.e. Hungate tubes) and autoclave. Thereafter add carbohydrate mixture, cysteine and sodium sulfide from concentrated sterile stock solutions (prepared anaerobically under N2 gas and autoclaved).

preparation_notes: 'Adjust pH to 6.7 - 6.8; gas atmosphere: 100% CO2.

  Dissolve ingredients except carbohydrates, Na2CO3, cysteine and sodium sulfide in
  distilled water, boil for 5 min, then cool to room temperature while gassing with
  100% CO2. Add Na2CO3 and equilibrate the medium with the gas to pH 6.8. Distribute
  under CO2 in rubber-stoppered tubes (i.e. Hungate tubes) and autoclave. Thereafter
  add carbohydrate mixture, cysteine and sodium sulfide from concentrated sterile
  stock solutions (prepared anaerobically under N2 gas and autoclaved).


  Original volume: 1001 mL'

preparation_notes: 'Adjust pH to 6.7 - 6.8; gas atmosphere: 100% CO2.

  Dissolve ingredients except carbohydrates, Na2CO3, cysteine and sodium sulfide in
  distilled water, boil for 5 min, then cool to room temperature while gassing with
  100% CO2. Add Na2CO3 and equilibrate the medium with the gas to pH 6.8. Distribute
  under CO2 in rubber-stoppered tubes (i.e. Hungate tubes) and autoclave. Thereafter
  add carbohydrate mixture, cysteine and sodium sulfide from concentrated sterile
  stock solutions (prepared anaerobically under N2 gas and autoclaved).


  Original volume: 1001 mL'

preparation_notes: 'Dissolve ingredients (except carbonate, glucose, maltose, cellobiose,
  soluble starch, cysteine and sulfide), then sparge medium with 100% CO2 gas for
  30 - 45 min to make it anoxic. Add the carbonate and equilibrate the medium with
  the CO2 gas to pH 6.8. Distribute under 100% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type
  tubes or serum vials and autoclave. Thereafter, add glucose, maltose, cellobiose,
  soluble starch, cysteine and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared
  under 100% N2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH of complete medium to 6.7 - 6.8, if necessary.


  Original volume: 1003 mL'

preparation_notes: 'Dissolve ingredients (except carbonate, glucose, maltose, cellobiose,
  soluble starch, cysteine and sulfide), then sparge medium with 100% CO2 gas for
  30 - 45 min to make it anoxic. Add the carbonate and equilibrate the medium with
  the CO2 gas to pH 6.8. Distribute under 100% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type
  tubes or serum vials and autoclave. Thereafter, add glucose, maltose, cellobiose,
  soluble starch, cysteine and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared
  under 100% N2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH of complete medium to 6.7 - 6.8, if necessary.


  Original volume: 1003 mL'

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients (except carbonate, glucose, maltose, cellobiose,
    soluble starch, cysteine and sulfide), then sparge medium with 100% CO2 gas for
    30 - 45 min to make it anoxic. Add the carbonate and equilibrate the medium with
    the CO2 gas to pH 6.8. Distribute under 100% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type
    tubes or serum vials and autoclave. Thereafter, add glucose, maltose, cellobiose,
    soluble starch, cysteine and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared
    under 100% N2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH of complete medium to 6.7 - 6.8, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Dissolve 50 mg haemin in 1 ml 1 N NaOH; make up to 100 ml with distilled
    water and filter sterilize. Store refrigerated.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients (except carbonate, glucose, maltose, cellobiose,
    soluble starch, cysteine and sulfide), then sparge medium with 100% CO2 gas for
    30 - 45 min to make it anoxic. Add the carbonate and equilibrate the medium with
    the CO2 gas to pH 6.8. Distribute under 100% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type
    tubes or serum vials and autoclave. Thereafter, add glucose, maltose, cellobiose,
    soluble starch, cysteine and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared
    under 100% N2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH of complete medium to 6.7 - 6.8, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Dissolve 50 mg haemin in 1 ml 1 N NaOH; make up to 100 ml with distilled
    water and filter sterilize. Store refrigerated.
applications:
- Microbial cultivation

330: RUMEN BACTERIA MEDIUM


Final pH: 6.7 - 6.8
Final volume: 1003 ml

   Mineral solution                                                  38.00        ml
   K2HPO4                                                             0.30          g
   Trypticase peptone (BD BBL)                                        2.00          g
   Yeast extract (OXOID)                                              0.50          g
   Volatile fatty acid mixture                                        3.10        ml
   Haemin solution (0.05% w/v)                                        2.00        ml
   Glycerol                                                           0.50          g
   Sodium resazurin (0.1% w/v)                                        0.50        ml
   Na2CO3                                                             4.00          g
   D-Glucose                                                          0.50          g
   Maltose                                                            0.50          g
   Cellobiose                                                         0.50          g
   Starch, soluble                                                    0.50          g
   L-Cysteine HCl x H2O                                               0.25          g
   Na2S x 9 H2O                                                       0.25          g
   Distilled water                                                 960.00         ml

Dissolve ingredients (except carbonate, glucose, maltose, cellobiose, soluble starch,
cysteine and sulfide), then sparge medium with 100% CO2 gas for 30 - 45 min to make it
anoxic. Add the carbonate and equilibrate the medium with the CO2 gas to pH 6.8.
Distribute under 100% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials
and autoclave. Thereafter, add glucose, maltose, cellobiose, soluble starch, cysteine and
sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas atmosphere. Adjust
pH of complete medium to 6.7 - 6.8, if necessary.


For DSM 17630, DSM 121616, DSM 121617, DSM 122475, DSM 122576, DSM 122577, DSM
123043, DSM 123047, DSM 123064, DSM 123065: Supplement the medium after
autoclaving with sterile and anoxic rumen fluid (30 ml/l).
